prompt: Create a rare lantern that reveals invisible creatures but also tempts its bearer to expose allies.
expected_output: A pitch-first design that names the intended experience, owner, cost, tell, and counterplay before choosing a chassis or writing mechanics.

assertions.text: States a one-sentence promise and intended experience before numbers
Includes a readable engagement loop (Tell → Choice → Cost → Payoff → Counterplay) with a meaningful cost or risk
Uses a familiar chassis or explains why a bespoke chassis is necessary
Does not grant unbounded always-on see-invisibility without a spend, tell, or exposure cost
